settings.name: Farhan Qureshi
settings.title: Safe oval shape & child-friendly corners
settings.content: The oval capsule shape is fantastic, especially because we have toddlers running around and there are no sharp 90-degree corners. The vertical cage bars around the curved perimeter look sensational.

settings.name: Zainab Meer
settings.title: Straight out of an interior design magazine
settings.content: Looks straight out of an Architectural Digest magazine! The dark marble top with deep undertones and the curved gold ribbed frame make it a true showstopper.

settings.name: Mohsin Raza
settings.title: Outstanding craftsmanship & warm champagne gold
settings.content: Outstanding craftsmanship. The oval top is perfectly aligned with the lower tier, and the gold finish has a warm champagne tone rather than cheap shiny yellow. Very happy customer.

settings.name: Samina Khalid
settings.title: Spacious yet easy to walk around
settings.content: Lovely pill-shaped table. It's spacious yet doesn't take up excessive walking space in the lounge. Very easy to wipe down.

settings.name: Waqas Butt
settings.title: Immaculate packaging & solid weight
settings.content: The packaging was immaculate and delivery arrived on time in 4 days. Sturdy frame, heavy marble tiers, and premium gold bars. Truly worth Rs. 16,500.

settings.name: Nimra Tahir
settings.title: Drawing room centerpiece
settings.content: Bought this for our newly renovated drawing room and everybody who visits asks where we bought it from! Gull e Gulzar has done an amazing job.

settings.name: Adeel Hassan
settings.title: Elite curved cage styling
settings.content: Excellent product quality and prompt customer service. The rounded cage style gives it such an elite look.
